figures.caption: Figure 4: The overview of our NExt, containing extracting reasoning patterns (Section 4.1) and extrapolating model parameters (Section 4.2) processes. Concretely, we first utilize LoRA-based RLVR to train the LLM and save the intermediate checkpoints. Next, we extract the rank-1 subspace of the difference between these saved checkpoints, and these deltas are utilized to train the predictor. Finally, the well-trained predictor will predict the model parameters, achieving the extrapolation.
